title: Invigilated Minesweeper-style task with GitHub Copilot
summary: CS1 novices have 30 minutes to solve a Minesweeper-style C++ programming task in VS Code with GitHub Copilot and other resources available. The task requires input, nested loops, two-dimensional storage, conditional updates, and output; researchers observe each student and follow with an interview.

sources.title: It's Weird That it Knows What I Want: Usability and Interactions with Copilot for Novice Programmers
sources.evidence_quote: Each participant had 30 minutes to complete the program and was allowed to utilize Copilot as well as any resource such as notes or the internet.

assessment.summary: Implement a Minesweeper-style C++ program using nested loops and two-dimensional data within 30 minutes.
student_actions: Write and test C++ code in VS Code.
